scope.compute: Measured on this machine using time.perf_counter_ns; not a Raspberry Pi or public-cloud measurement.
scope.network: configured network emulation; not a measured public cloud

workload.sample_selection: evenly spaced positions across the complete augmented file
workload.role: architecture latency, throughput, routing, and Web-3D replay; excluded from model fitting and accuracy evaluation

configured_cloud_path.definition: local compute proxy plus configured network latency; not a public-cloud measurement

parameters.label: configured network emulation; not a measured public cloud

configured_end_to_end.twin_staleness_proxy: Equal to configured end-to-end latency; browser render latency is not included.
configured_end_to_end.warning: Includes configured, not field-measured, network latency.

routing.rule: Cloud when voltage/current is zero or observed legacy power exceeds 42.6 W; otherwise edge.
routing.basis: p99 legacy power in the real calibration trace; invalid electrical readings are also routed to cloud

throughput.definition: sample count divided by summed local inference compute time
